summary:
Ainta's n-point simple-zero refinement of Theorem D of the pinned Zeta23 development at
n = 6 with pair weights a_{ij} (symmetrised under gap reversal) and per-gap pressures b_r, made unconditional by a
finite certificate (6,814 table cells, 108 bisection trees with 18,058 leaves on the half-space g₀ ≤ g₄, the rest by
the reflection symmetry of the functional) verified inside Lean by a generic soundness theorem for an integer interval
checker (Taylor enclosures of cos/sin at scale 10¹⁵); the certificate is data evaluated by the kernel. No new axioms.
method: Six-point weighted simple-zero refinement of the Montgomery–Taylor rank-trace certificate (symmetric pair weights, half-space by reflection); finite certificate checked by a verified integer checker.
